rationale: The stock gapped up ~6.7% on strong earnings and has been selling off from the session high of $70.48, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear downward sequence from $70.28 to $69.36 on elevated volume — suggesting distribution near the highs. The 9-EMA ($69.78) is now above price, confirming short-term momentum has turned down, but the broader market is weak (SPY -1.31%, VIXY +7.50%), making a long risky; simultaneously, the fundamental catalyst (strong earnings beat, Zacks #1) and still-elevated relative volume (8.28x) make a short against a fresh gap-up dangerous. The risk/reward is unclear in both directions at this mid-range, mid-session juncture.
